title: Exchange Tokenized-Trading Rule Crosswalk
adds: No. The Commission approved Nasdaq's rules on 2026-03-18, and five NYSE-family exchanges plus 24X filed immediately effective rules. Tokenization is an optional post-trade settlement-form flag: same CUSIP, symbol, order book, priority and fees; market data does not distinguish forms; settlement stays T+1. DTC decides eligibility, and anything ineligible falls back to traditional settlement. No operative start notice was located. About 11% of DTC participants were excluded per the 24X filing. 'The most important word is ... fungible.'
contribution_scope: Reviewed navigation description; read each source for its own claim and clock.
navigation_contribution: See what exchange tokenization flags and rule changes affect, what remains within the existing market structure and which launch gates remain.
